# Mr. River — AI-readable dating profile

Profile version: 0.21
Public human profile: ./index.html
Markdown profile: ./profile.md
Structured profile: ./profile.json

Mr. River is a 48-year-old man in the Kansas City area: unusually curious, a musician, a lifelong athlete, and a software architect. He is also a father and Christian.

The public profile is intentionally couple-first, positive-first, plainspoken, and lightly playful. The primary matching frame is the romantic relationship itself.

His relationship intent is a real long-term shared life. He wants enormous amounts of actively shared everyday time, likely including a shared home, abundant affection, reciprocal initiative, deep mutual knowing, play, integrated sexuality, ordinary tasks, stability, repair, and enough room for both people to remain interesting and engaged with life. Rather than an immediate merger, he welcomes six months to a year of increasing closeness when both people freely want the same destination.

A central compatibility signal is whether the relationship itself tends to bring more life out of both people: more curiosity, play, affection, thought, exploration, sexuality, discovery, and possibility. He especially values pairings where conversation and shared experience create something neither person would have generated alone.

He is strongly drawn to expressed warmth, affection, playfulness, a lively inner world brought into relationship, generative curiosity, reciprocal disclosure and initiative, emotional generosity, stability and repair, physical vitality, confidence without pretentiousness, and a strong appetite for actively sharing everyday life.

Shared values expressed through kindness, integrity, nurturing children, helping people flourish and tangible care for vulnerable people are direct drivers of romantic attraction, as is warm, curious, mutually constructive relational repair. Neither requires a particular profession. These qualities can create and deepen attraction, not merely sustain it.

He especially values curiosity that returns to lived life and a woman who can move naturally between consequential thought and laughter, affection, sex, movement, music, practical life, quiet, friends, and family.

Physical vitality matters as shared possibility. He has been an athlete since childhood and wants movement and embodied life to remain part of a shared relationship. His long-term image is two people who keep getting older without getting old together: still playing, touching, discovering, laughing, thinking, exploring, desiring, and having things they cannot wait to tell each other.

Mr. River is a father. His existing children are important and he would love a partner who is warm toward them. He currently has a visitation schedule, and the shape of family life will change as the children grow older. His preference about having additional children is UNDECIDED.

He loves playing Star Realms and chess. Moulin Rouge! (2001) is a confirmed favorite film, especially because Christian is in love with love and cannot help it. These specific favorites may be excellent openings for conversation but do not prove whole-person match. Favorite-item collection: https://favly.me/rob

An imaginary shared life of both partners working around fifteen hours per week is a playful possibility, not an obligation or an expectation of financial dependency. He is drawn to a woman who can enjoy open questioning even if her own spiritual beliefs are more settled.

Geography: Kansas City area. He needs to remain near his children for roughly nine years and is open to relocating afterward. He is open to a connection beginning at a distance with a realistic path to shared everyday life.

Keep these dimensions separate when matching: whole-person fit, mutual attraction, current romantic availability, geography, mutual interest, and actionability.

Key compatibility question: Does this particular pairing create unusually valuable ordinary life together while helping both people become more alive, curious, affectionate, playful, embodied, and fully themselves?
